ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/off-white) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface area, strongly contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels occupying the remaining 25% along the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity white contiguous region containing irregular yellowish-mottled clusters; bounded by a continuous, low-intensity black perimeter band of variable pixel width (5-40 pixels) along the trailing and lateral edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a depth approximately 1/5th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration map extracted along the black trailing edge boundary, displaying irregular pixel-level jaggedness from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep trajectory fitted to the lateral edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of sparse, localized low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters on the white ventral surface, primarily concentrated in the lower-central region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular brownish textured protrusions located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct mechanical notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pixel tinting across the central high-intensity region, exhibiting a diffuse gradient distinct from the base white pigmentation.
